verdict.rationale: The s.jina.ai search endpoint takes a query and, in the same call, fetches the top 5 results, visits each URL, and runs the Reader conversion on it, so it returns full LLM-friendly page content rather than just links and snippets. Site filtering is also shown in the documented examples. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of search-with-content quality, and documentation of controls over result count beyond the fixed top 5.
